name: Office Documents (OfficeCLI)
description: Create, inspect, and edit Word/Excel/PowerPoint documents (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx) in sessions. Powered by the OfficeCLI binary: DOM path addressing, CSS-style queries, atomic batch edits, OpenXML validation, template merge, and HTML/PNG rendering to check layout. The binary downloads on first use (pinned version tag + SHA-256 check); Microsoft Office is not required.
changelog: Initial release: office_view/office_get/office_query/office_dump/office_create/office_edit/office_batch/office_merge/office_validate/office_render/office_help tools for .docx/.xlsx/.pptx powered by OfficeCLI.

fields.label: OfficeCLI binary path
fields.description: Absolute path to an installed officecli executable. When empty the plugin downloads the official binary for the current platform (pinned version tag, SHA-256 verified).

fields.label: Binary version tag
fields.description: GitHub Release tag used when auto-downloading. Only applies when binaryPath is not set.

fields.label: Auto-download binary
fields.description: Download the officecli binary to the user directory on first use. When disabled and no binary is installed, tools show installation instructions.
